findings.rationale: The policy grants every IAM action, so the trust boundary is effectively unlimited.
The policy uses a wildcard resource, so it does not constrain which AWS objects can be touched.
The wildcard IAM statement is paired with a public-read bucket ACL, creating a direct identity-to-exposure chain.
findings.traces_to: tf_iam_open Statement[0] (Action/Resource '*') chained with tf_s3_public_access aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket acl = 'public-read'
